propositions: Direct gated-close phase timings must be measured and recorded in COMPLETION_VERDICT.metrics payload for both PASS and FAIL verdicts without adding I/O, subprocess calls, network calls, locks, or model calls
Instrumentation overhead must remain below 50 microseconds per close operation as validated by ABBA-pattern CPU-time microbenchmark on a 2714-entry synthetic history

Ten named timing fields (pre_verifier_total_ms, structural_scan_ms, material_policy_ms, descendant_scope_ms, landing_check_ms, verifier_call_ms, git_history_read_ms, alias_index_build_ms, ticket_ref_resolution_ms, diff_validation_ms) must be recorded by threading optional metrics dictionary through existing call graph
Duration probe must consume direct timing fields when present and label older records lacking them as legacy_uninstrumented without causal operation attribution
Optional timing dictionary argument must not affect existing callers or preserve backward compatibility when not supplied
Existing completion consumption metrics and subprocess/sidecar call counts must remain unchanged after instrumentation is added
